title: 808s & Heartbreak [Cover 1]
description: Straying from the colorful, striking artworks from Ye's previous albums, the artwork for 808s & Heartbreak, consists of an almost featureless background, saving room for a deflated heart-shaped balloon and a small color palette to the left, in which each color represents a song from the album, with one exception. It's about the last song "Pinocchio Story", which signifies this song as the one where he truly poured out his heart (hence, the deflated heart in the center).
people: Past Tell Museum, JP Robinson, Kristen Yiengst & Virgil Abloh

title: YEEZY 700 V3
description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 ‘Dark Glow’ features a black engineered mesh upper with charcoal accents and smoky RPU overlays — a neutral design that’s virtually identical to the ‘Alvah’ colorway from April 2020. The key difference centers around the sneaker’s glow-in-the-dark RPU cage, which emits a blue luminescence versus the older shoe’s green-tinged glow. Lightweight cushioning arrives via a solid black EVA midsole with an encapsulated polyurethane core. Underfoot, a herringbone-traction rubber outsole delivers superior grip.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANTS
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infants ‘Slate’ utilizes a light grey Primeknit upper designed to hug little feet in a snug, sock-like fit. The flexible one-piece build features no-tie elastic laces and center-stitch detailing down the vamp. A streak of black on the shoe’s lateral side is marked with ‘SPLY-350’ branding, while adidas’ signature three-stripes is concealed on the interior heel. Semi-translucent TPU envelops a full-length Boost midsole, good for soft landings and a comfortable ride.
